title: Quarterly Roadmap Pulse: Hosted API & Model Catalog Initiative Grid
creator: Maya Chen
description: Objective: Create a compact, repeatable quarterly 'pulse' artifact that maps initiatives across Hosted API and Model Catalog into a single grid for stakeholders (Eng, Design, SRE, Sales). The artifact will support OKR alignment, release windows, capacity gating, and dependency visualization so leadership can make prioritization tradeoffs quickly. This ticket scopes the first iteration: define template, populate Q1 initiatives, run two stakeholder reviews, and publish to Confluence and the roadmap dashboard.
acceptance_criteria: Pulse artifact template finalized and stored in Confluence
All active Hosted API and Model Catalog initiatives for Q1 are mapped with owner, milestone, and dependency status
Top-3 risks and mitigations identified for each initiative
Console roadmap dashboard updated with release windows and expected SLAs for each milestone
Stakeholder review sign-offs from Eng, Design, SRE, and Sales
initiative_grid_summary: Grid rows enumerate initiatives (e.g., 'Hosted API: streaming improvements', 'Model Catalog: verified model gating', 'Hosted API: pricing experiment'), columns include OKR alignment, milestone dates, release window, owner, dependencies, customer impact, and success metrics. Each cell contains a concise status tag (On Track / At Risk / Blocked).
metrics_and_okr_alignment: OKR-H1: Reduce average token cost by 18% while maintaining quality - initiatives mapped to cost/quantization and routing policies
OKR-H2: Improve production latency (p95) by 20ms for typical 512-token requests - initiatives mapped to batching and kernel tuning
Success metrics per initiative: p95 latency, token cost per 1M, model quality regression <= 1% on eval suite, rollout failure rate < 1%
gating_criteria: Model onboarding: verified performance profile + regression test pass on canonical prompt set
Hosted API feature release: perf budget met on staging (p95 and cost) and SRE runbook updated
Dedicated capacity features: autoscale policy exercised in load test >= 2x expected traffic
Security/compliance: KMS integration validated for private deployments if customer-impacting
risks: Perf regressions discovered late in canary leading to release delays
Cross-team dependency on infra changes (kernel updates) slipping the milestone
Insufficient capacity on Dedicated clusters during peak spikes
Ambiguous ownership for model deprecation windows causing customer confusion
mitigations: Early staging stress tests and mandatory perf sign-off two weeks before release
Weekly cross-functional syncs focused on top-5 interlocks with action owners
Reserve burst capacity budget for Known high-risk launches
Publish clear model deprecation policy and migration paths in docs; communicate to customers 30/14/7 days before changes
